prayerExcerpt.en-US: Rescued from the slavery of corruption, may we merit an incorruptible inheritance.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Libertos da corrupção, mereçamos alcançar a herança incorruptível.

meta.face: A stocky, broad-shouldered man of about fifty-five with a wide, rectangular face and a heavy, fleshy jaw on a thick neck — a low, broad forehead, a broad nose with a wide, flat bridge, small, shrewd, kindly hazel eyes set deep under a heavy brow with thick, straight black-and-grey brows, full cheeks, a wide, generous mouth; thick, straight, coarse hair of black mixed with grey, cropped short and combed forward in a blunt Roman fringe low on the brow (NOT bald, no curls); a short, dense, square-trimmed black-and-grey beard close to the face; a frank, warm, direct gaze.
meta.basis: A former slave who rose to be pope; the medallion portrait in the series of popes at St Paul Outside the Walls (Wikipedia lead image, a pre-1823 fresco) shows a broad face and a short, full beard. The card keeps that sturdy, plain build (with a Roman fringe rather than a bald crown, to stay apart from Sixtus II in batch 7), set in Trastevere, where his titulus stood and where tradition places the well of his martyrdom.
